settings.native_config:
runtime:
  worker_threads: 2
api:
  http:
    listen: 127.0.0.1:9199
log:
  level: debug
  file: ./state/oxidns.log
  rotation:
    type: daily
    max_files: 3
plugins:
- tag: rules_domain_1
  type: domain_set
  args:
    exps:
    - full:a.example.test
    files:
    - ./rules/rule_571b0e3555013658_domain.txt
    - ./rules/rule_b604257892f6c012_domain.txt
- tag: lazy_cache
  type: cache
  args:
    size: 10240
    lazy_cache_ttl: 3600
    short_circuit: true
- tag: forward_local
  type: forward
  args:
    concurrent: 2
    upstreams:
    - addr: udp://192.0.2.11
- tag: forward_remote
  type: forward
  args:
    concurrent: 1
    upstreams:
    - addr: https://1.1.1.1/dns-query
    - addr: https://8.8.8.8/dns-query
- tag: forward_fallback
  type: forward
  args:
    concurrent: 2
    upstreams:
    - addr: udp://192.0.2.53
- tag: ros_address_list
  type: ros_address_list
  args:
    address: https://192.0.2.1
    username: u
    password: p
    async: true
    address_list4: oxidns
    address_list6: oxidns
    min_ttl: 60
    max_ttl: 3600
    queue_capacity: 16384
    comment_prefix: configflow
    cleanup_on_shutdown: true
- tag: china_dns
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: $ros_address_list
  - exec: $lazy_cache
  - exec: $forward_local
  - matches:
    - '!has_resp'
    exec: reject 3
- tag: local_probe
  type: sequence
  args:
  - matches:
    - '!has_resp'
    exec: $forward_local
  - exec: return
- tag: remote_dns
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: $forward_remote
  - matches:
    - '!has_resp'
    exec: reject 3
  - exec: ttl 1
- tag: fallback_dns
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: $forward_fallback
  - matches:
    - '!has_resp'
    exec: reject 3
- tag: fallback
  type: fallback
  args:
    primary: remote_dns
    secondary: fallback_dns
    threshold: 500
    always_standby: false
- tag: proxy_dns_seq
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: $fallback
  - exec: accept
- tag: default_direct_ip
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: $ros_address_list
  - exec: accept
- tag: direct_ip
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: $ros_address_list
  - exec: accept
- tag: ip_requery_proxy
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: drop_resp
  - exec: goto proxy_dns_seq
- tag: sequence_main
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: metrics_collector metrics
  - exec: prefer_ipv4
  - matches:
    - qtype 64 28
    exec: black_hole nodata short_circuit=true
  - matches:
    - qname $rules_domain_1
    exec: goto china_dns
  - exec: goto proxy_dns_seq
- tag: server_udp
  type: udp_server
  args:
    listen: 0.0.0.0:53
    entry: 5
- tag: rules_download
  type: download
  args:
    timeout: 60s
    downloads:
    - url: http://config.test/api/mosdns/rule-proxy?url=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.test%2Flist.txt&part=domain&token=test-only
      dir: rules
      filename: rule_571b0e3555013658_domain.txt
    - url: http://config.test/api/mosdns/rule-proxy?url=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.test%2Fother.txt&part=domain&token=test-only
      dir: rules
      filename: rule_b604257892f6c012_domain.txt
- tag: rules_reload
  type: reload_provider
  args:
  - $rules_domain_1
- tag: rules_refresh
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: $rules_download
  - exec: $rules_reload
